contractCoverage.obligation: Duplicate 1:N/N:1 and N:M keys remain one result row; N:M never expands cartesian rows and requires policy.
One row per key retains original/normalized values, conversion status, and comparison provenance.
Malformed rule values report conversion failure with side-specific conversion provenance.
Malformed tagged scalar envelopes are rejected deterministically.
Stale/ambiguous template column references do not apply silently.
Malformed/oversized CSV and ZIP, encryption, unsafe paths, formulas, macros, and decompression/resource limits produce diagnostics.
No API route/server action/server fallback or fetch upload exists.
Browser summary/result rows and CSV/JSON download shape are deterministic.
Worker cancellation protocol and loader row/byte/cell guards are present and exercised by bounded checks.
